description: For a dose question, use studied_doses together with get_community_practice. Return a precomputed summary of one peptide: identity, sequence, checked findings by evidence class, trials, key findings with citations, coverage and notices. regulatory gives approval by place and use, plus sport status. Use this for an overview of a known peptide. Use resolve_peptide first for an unclear name, search_findings for a specific outcome, or compare_peptides for 2 to 5 peptides. Counts and key findings use administered findings only. The key_findings_v0.4 rule excludes method-only outcome groups when other groups have findings. Its order is evidence class, design tier, analysis role, sample size, citations, then newer. coverage.checked_years gives the year span of checked papers. coverage.search_scope_years gives the search scope. Trials counted test the peptide. evidence_summary.trials.other_registry_entries counts entries that only measure or mention it. Notices describe coverage limits. Each finding has an evidence class: human, animal, laboratory or predicted. A count of 0 human findings means no checked human findings within the filters or outcome group. It does not mean that no human study exists. Returned doses are the doses that studies used, with species, route, design and source.

community.description: Include community reports. Needs the community dataset grant. Default false.

peptide.description: Peptide name, alias, slug or ID. Examples: BPC-157, semaglutide, PEP-000001.
